description: Search Kamernet, HousingAnywhere, and 11 Dutch anti-squat agency sites for one city, province, or the whole Netherlands. Returns one deduplicated list with rent, size, type, municipal registration status with the proving sentence, hide reasons, and new since last run flags. Detail pages and landlord message drafts on your own model key are optional. Pararius, Huurwoningen, Funda, and Gapph are not covered. Pay per event on Apify.

applicantProfile.description: Facts about you for the drafts, as JSON such as {"name": "Sam", "age": 29, "work": "software engineer", "move_in": "2026-12-01", "contact": "sam@example.com"} or plain lines. The model restates only these facts.

availableBy.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Drop listings available only after this day. A listing with no date stays.

blockedLandlordIds.description: Landlord account IDs (landlord_id) whose listings are returned as free hidden_listing rows instead of charged rows.

draftMessages.description: true: write a first message to each landlord with your own model key and applicantProfile. Turns on includeDetails. Needs llmApiKey; without one the run fails with a plain error.

excludeGenderOnly.description: true: a listing whose text limits it to one gender becomes a free hidden_listing row with the matched sentence. false: it is returned with the reason in hide_reasons.

excludeLanguageOnly.description: true: a listing whose text limits it to Dutch or Polish speakers becomes a free hidden_listing row.

excludeShortStay.description: true: a listing whose text or listed maximum stay is under 3 months becomes a free hidden_listing row.

excludeStudentOnly.description: true: a listing whose text limits it to students becomes a free hidden_listing row.

furnished.description: Keep only these: furnished, unfurnished, uncarpeted. A listing that does not say stays.

hasInternet.description: Kamernet's own filter, sent with the search.

includeDetails.description: true: read each returned listing's detail page for the full text, house rules, landlord type, deposit, and the text based registration and hide rules. Charged per page read. Default false.

includeLandlordName.description: true: add the landlord's display name. Off by default, because on Kamernet most landlords are private people.

llmApiKey.description: Your own key for the provider above. It goes only to that provider, is never stored or logged, and is never sent to the model.

llmModel.description: A model name from your provider. Empty uses gpt-4o-mini, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, gemini-2.5-flash, or llama-3.3-70b-versatile.

llmProvider.description: openai (default), anthropic, gemini, or groq. Used only with draftMessages.

location.description: A Dutch city (Kamernet's 212 cities, such as Utrecht or Den Haag), a province as province:noord-holland, or netherlands for the whole country. A bare name that is both a city and a province (Utrecht, Groningen) is the city.

maxDrafts.description: Most messages to draft in one run. Default 20.

maxRent.description: Drop listings above this rent. A listing with no rent stays.

maxResults.description: Listings to return as charged rows. Default 50.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Free rows are always returned.

minRooms.description: Drop listings with fewer rooms. Kamernet states rooms only on the detail page, so this works there with includeDetails on.

minSize.description: Drop listings smaller than this. A listing with no size stays.

propertyTypes.description: Keep only these: room, studio, apartment, house, anti-squat, student-residence, other. Empty keeps all.

radiusKm.description: Kamernet only: also search this far around the city. 0, 1, 2, 5, 10 (default), or 20; other values round up. HousingAnywhere and the agencies search the city itself.

registrationOnly.description: true: keep only listings whose text or listed field says municipal registration is possible (registration_status yes, listed_yes, or flag). Text needs includeDetails on.

roommateGenders.description: Kamernet's own filter: male, female, mixed.

roommatesMax.description: Kamernet's own filter: none, up_to_4, or up_to_8.

sources.description: kamernet, housinganywhere, antisquat_agencies (11 Dutch anti-squat agency sites). Default: all three.

tenantAge.description: Kamernet's own filter: your age in years, 16 to 99.

tenantGender.description: Kamernet's own filter: male or female.

trackChanges.description: true (default): keep first seen and last seen for this search in a named key-value store in your own Apify account, so later runs mark new and stale listings.

name: search_dutch_rental_listings
title: Search Netherlands rental listings
